predeclared_criteria.clearly_bad: Both pooled effects worsen by more than their competitive limits and fewer than 2 primary windows improve; no refinement is warranted.
predeclared_criteria.competitive: Paired delta MAE is no worse than +0.20 primary and +0.30 H12, with at least 2 of 6 primary windows improving or tied.
predeclared_criteria.maximum_if_parent_approves: Reuse exact Stage 5 inner protocol: same 2 parameter sets x 5 rank weights at the same six temporal cutoffs (at most 12 new inner SVD128 fits). Refit only selected outer parameter choices not already represented by the paired outer fit. No new parameter or weight grid.
predeclared_criteria.mixed: One pooled primary/H12 effect improves by at least 0.20 MAE while the other worsens by no more than 0.40, or primary has at least 2 improving and 2 worsening windows with both pooled deltas within +/-0.25.
predeclared_criteria.stage: No second-stage SVD128 inner selection is run without the parent agent's review/approval.
